rationale: The phone snatch is a covered theft under Baggage and Personal Effects (wording section 5): the police report was made the same day, the receipt supports the $899 value, and the per-item limit on Premium gives $300 less the $50 deductible, or $250. However, the same loss was already claimed and paid as CLM-0987 (filed July 16, 2026, $250), and the manual (sections 8 and 9) requires a referral to the Special Investigations Unit when the same loss is claimed twice. The SIU should confirm whether CLM-0987 and CLM-1024 cover the same phone and decide whether any second payment is due; the customer should be told only that the claim is under review.
